doc.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

title: Don Albert's wife
summary: Albert met his wife in New Orleans, not on the road; she has been wonderful.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did you meet your wife on the road? No, I met her here.
In fact, I met her late at morning. Oh, so you've known her for a number of years. No, no, no, no.
And you're still married to the same woman?
No, no, no. No, it's too late on the stuff. Nobody wants you, man.
She's been a wonderful woman. I've got to do a lot of things. Yeah, that's right.
